ev.q: Overall, 5,671 persons from 28 LTCFs were tested, including 2,868 (50.6%) residents and 2,803 (49.4%) staff members.
resident prevalence was 28.0% in the response group and 0.5% in the preventive group (p<0.01)
637 (11.2%) persons received positive test results for SARS-CoV-2
Overall, 5,671 persons from 28 LTCFs were tested
SARS-CoV-2 infection was identified in 25.8% of residents and 8.7% of staff members
resident prevalence was 28.0% in the response group and 0.5% in the preventive group (p<0.01)
the proportion of residents hospitalized because of COVID-19 did not differ significantly between the response (19.9%) and preventive (29.4%) groups (p = 0.36)
This analysis sought to evaluate the timing at which mass testing took place
facility-wide testing at the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic focused on LTCFs that already had at least one known confirmed case

methods_quotes.q: Fisher’s exact tests were used to test differences between facility groups
p-values <0.05 were considered to be statistically significant
p-value results of Fisher’s exact test comparing all LTCFs in the preventive group to all LTCFs in the response group
